definition: A deal with stage 'prospecting' or 'negotiation' — it has not yet closed, won or lost.
A deal with stage 'closed_won' or 'closed_lost' — a deal that has finished, regardless of outcome.
The number of closed_won deals divided by all closed deals (closed_won + closed_lost), expressed as a percentage.
The employee with the highest total deal_value summed across their closed_won deals.
The sum of deal_value for all active deals (stage 'prospecting' or 'negotiation') — money not yet won or lost.
The average deal_value across closed_won deals, unless the question specifies a different subset.
The average number of days between created_date and closed_date for closed deals. Also called deal velocity.
A customer whose signup_date is within the last 90 days of the most recent date in the data.
The sum of deal_value for closed_won deals owned by employees belonging to a given department, joined through employees.department_id.
